The TwinArm Robotic Arm is developed and manufactured based on the open-source LeRobot project’s Koch V1.1 from Hugging Face. It fully meets the hardware requirements of the open-source project, while achieving significant enhancements in appearance, manufacturing process, and quality. This product is ready for immediate use and enables users to quickly engage in research related to the LeRobot project. Key Improvements Soft and Hard Material Gripper Design: Enhanced gripping capability with a production process combining soft and hard materials. Production-Grade Manufacturing: Increased stability over DIY products with professional-grade production processes. Standardized Quality Control: Ensures consistent reliability across all units. Durable Engineering Plastic Construction: Built for long-lasting performance with a heat deflection temperature exceeding 90°C. Packing List One Leader Arm and one Follower Arm (including 12 DYNAMIXEL servos, two servo driver boards, a 12V to 5V step-down module, and pre-assembled components) 12V power adapter 5V power adapter Two Type-C cables (1.5 meters each) Two C-clamps
